purpose: Teach: オリックス/テレビ朝日/スズキ/男優/ソビエト/ケニア/司馬/ブルジョアジー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがオリックスのジャージを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father gave you an Orix baseball jersey.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Gentle pride in sharing what Ryosuke did. Soft landing on the final word — noticing Sho's attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとテレビ朝日のニュース観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched the TV Asahi news together.
lines.style: Bright, earnest rush of words. The specific need to share every detail with her. Open, unguarded — eager for her to understand how Dad spent time with him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスズキ自動車工場を見学された
lines.en: Sho, your father visited the Suzuki automobile factory.
lines.style: Quiet observational tone. Slightly meditative — as if she's noticing a pattern in what Ryosuke is sharing with their son. Gentle cadence, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと男優のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a documentary about an actor.
lines.style: Quick, genuine excitement. Each detail matters — he's relaying it exactly as he experienced it. Slight breathlessness from the urge to tell her everything he learned.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが旧ソビエトの歴史を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father taught you about the history of the Soviet Union.
lines.style: Quieter still. Speaking almost to herself — recognising something deliberate in Ryosuke's choices. Tender but observant. Weight in the pause before the verb.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとケニアの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a picture book about Kenya.
lines.style: Unbroken enthusiasm. The catalogue of learning moments continues — his voice completely present in each one. Eager to demonstrate that he's absorbing what Dad shares.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが司馬遼太郎の本を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father lent you a book by Shiba Ryotaro.
lines.style: Warmth with quiet understanding underneath. The observations have deepened — she's seeing Ryosuke's quiet intentionality. Slow, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとブルジョアジーのお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me a story about the bourgeoisie.
lines.style: Final rush of joy. Sho's voice clings to the memory — 'told me a story' carries the weight of connection. Warm and full, then a slight fadeout as if tucking it away safely.
